name: Embarrassed_1
short_caption: The robot looks down and nervously fidgets with its hands in front of its waist to show embarrassment.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and slowly tilts its head downward while bringing both hands together in front of its lower torso. It curls its fingers and subtly moves its hands in a nervous, fidgeting clasping motion. After a brief pause in this guarded posture, it slowly releases its hands, lifts its head back up, and returns both arms to its sides.
safety_notes: The arms stay very close to the torso during this motion, presenting minimal collision risk.
